AS ONE Corporation
is a major Japanese distributor and manufacturer of scientific research instruments, laboratory equipment, and hospital/nursing care supplies.
It does not manufacture or brand consumer continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or personal remote patient monitoring platforms
Global Data
If you meant a brand that
does
provide these consumer and medical wearable health technologies, here is how the choices compare:
Wearable Health Tech Options
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Devices like the
Abbott Lingo
or
Ultrahuman M1
use a tiny sensor placed under the skin to track interstitial sugar levels 24/7 and stream data via Bluetooth to a smartphone app.
Smartwatches & Wearable ECGs:
Smartwatches (such as Apple, Samsung, or specialized health watches) use photoplethysmography (PPG) and electrical sensors to log heart rates, record single-lead ECGs, and estimate general fitness metrics. Note that non-invasive wrist-based blood glucose smartwatches are not clinically validated or approved as medical replacements for CGMs.
